situation: Activation fell 12% after the redesigned onboarding flow shipped. Leadership asks for a plan to fix it by Friday.

gate.reason: A single fix plan would treat a discoverable user-behaviour problem as a knowable one.

pieces.name: Possible bug in the new flow
evidence: The drop began on the day of the release, so a code cause is plausible.
Funnel data and session replay already exist and can show where users stop.

second_reading.tipping_condition: The funnel shows one obviously broken step with an error in the logs.

approach.summary: Analyse the funnel and replays for a regression. Fix it if found.
approach.analysis_needed: Step-by-step funnel comparison before and after release, plus 20 session replays at the drop point.
experts: Front-end engineer who built the flow

reclassify_triggers: The analysis finds a plain bug that explains the full 12%. Treat the fix as Clear work.

pieces.name: Why real users do not activate
evidence: No team member can say why users stop. Three internal theories contradict each other.
Earlier onboarding changes had effects that nobody predicted before launch.

second_reading.tipping_condition: The regression analysis explains the whole drop and leaves nothing to discover.

pieces.boundary_risk: Drifts toward Complicated if the team accepts one theory without testing it.

approach.summary: Run small experiments on real users. Do not write the full redesign yet.

probes.action: Show the old first screen to 10% of new signups.

safe_to_fail.why: A feature flag turns it off at once and the old screen is still in the codebase.

probes.signal: Activation rate of the 10% group against the new-flow group.
probes.amplify_if: The old screen activates at least 5 points higher.
probes.dampen_if: No difference after 1,000 signups per arm.

probes.action: Add a one-question prompt at the drop point: what stopped you?

safe_to_fail.bounded_cost: One small UI element, half a day of work
safe_to_fail.why: It is optional, can be removed by flag, and does not change the flow.

probes.signal: Share of answers that fall into the same 2 or 3 themes.
probes.amplify_if: One theme holds more than 30% of answers.
probes.dampen_if: Under 5% of users answer, or answers are all different.

reclassify_triggers: Probes show a stable, repeatable cause. Move the fix to Complicated and plan it.
Probes show an effect nobody predicted. Stay Complex and run the next probe.
